Vs. 
Halima Khatun and others ------ Opposite Parties
full_judgment: 10. Mr Probir Neogi the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits• that the impugned, judgment is not a proper judgment of reversal inasmuch as the Court of appeal below set aside the decision of the trial Court without adverting to the finding forming the basis of such decision. The learned. Advocate further submits that having regard to the findings of the appellate Court itself and terms of the remand the Court of appeal below committed an error of law resulting in erroneous decision occasioning failure of justice in passing the impugned judgment and decree inasmuch as it is settled that order of remand cannot be made to give the erring party opportunity to fill up the lacuna in pleadings and evidence. The learned Advocate also submits that having regard to the purpose of impugned order of remand as stated in the ordering portion of the impugned judgment 'বাদী পক্ষকে প্রদর্শনী আই সিরিজ চিহ্নিত কগজাদি ও সঠিকতা সম্পর্কে আরজির প্রয়োজনীয় সংশোধনী সহ মৌখিক ও দালিলিক সাক্ষ্য দাখিল এবং দাবীকৃত বেদখল সম্পর্কে ও আরজির প্রয়োজনীয় সংশোধনীসহ মৌখিক ও দালিলিক সাক্ষ্য দাখিলের সুযোগ প্রদান করিবার উদ্দেশ্যে মূল মোকাদ্দমাটি পুনঃবিচারের জন্য নিম্ন আদালতে প্রেরণ করা হইল।' the Court of appeal below committed serious error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice inasmuch as it is apparent on the face of the impugned judgment that the order of remand has been made for the sole purpose of giving the plaintiffs an opportunity for the second time to fill up the lacuna in the pleadings and evidence. The learned Advocate lastly submits that is an elementary principle and practice of law that when the plaintiff is given opportunity to amend the plaint and adduce additional evidence, the defendant is legally entitled to equal and corresponding opportunity, and that elementary principle and practice of law having been violated in the instant case, the impugned judgment and decree are liable to be set aside and having regard to the fact and circumstances of the case, especially, the fact of earlier remand, the impugned judgment and decree are not sustainable in law.
